Fixed deterministic xorshift graph with nodes<=32 (edges 0->1,0->2,1->3,2->3,2->4,3->5,4->5,6->0): reach from 0 = {0..5}, bfs 0:0 1:1 2:1 3:2 4:2 5:3, cc all 0..6 labelled 0.  u64 top time (not upstream unit), so reach uses distinct and bfs reduce; cc drops the leading-zeros delay (plain enter) as propagate.c does
